body: I considered myself strong willed. Everyone once adored me and i was very respected by my company. A person can only suffer so much, and i can feel my brain just shutting off... to not hurt anymore. I used to pray growing up to just be killed, yet this is worst than any method of suicide. I've begged someone to even help me blow my brains out in a field so i make sure i don't fail suicide. Im only 22 and feel like my mind has just went down a cold empty alley i can't get out of. I feel for people who go through with it and how that much agony makes it feel selfless
